description_for_human: Rent computation from a peer-to-peer network, paid in USDC on Solana against on-chain proof of work.
description_for_model: Open compute protocol for AI agents. Discover providers, get a USDC price quote via x402, lock USDC in an on-chain escrow, run an isolated workload, verify the ed25519-signed result, and release payment minus a 4% fee. No account or API key. Supports spend caps, read-only mode, idempotency keys, queryable reputation, and signed receipts. Payment is USDC on Solana (devnet today, mainnet planned). The USDC mint is provider-specific and always arrives in the quote.

mcp.install: claude mcp add cloudiy -- cloudiy mcp
